name: engineering_delivery
description: Inspect, plan, approve, implement, verify, and review a complex engineering change.

steps.title: Inspect project facts
steps.prompt: Inspect the requested change, relevant code, tests, constraints, and existing behavior. Return concrete evidence and risks without modifying files.

steps.title: Build an implementation plan
steps.prompt: Using the inspection result, produce a minimal implementation plan with affected files, verification commands, safety boundaries, and rollback points.

steps.title: Approve implementation
steps.prompt: Review the inspection evidence and implementation plan before workspace mutation.

steps.title: Implement the approved change
steps.prompt: Implement the approved plan in the current workspace. Preserve existing behavior, keep changes scoped, and do not publish, commit, or push.

steps.title: Run verification
steps.prompt: Run the most relevant automated tests and static checks. Fix only regressions caused by this workflow and report fresh evidence.

steps.title: Review final state
steps.prompt: Review the final diff and verification evidence for correctness, security, compatibility, and unrequested changes. Do not modify files.

steps.title: Delivery checkpoint
steps.prompt: Implementation, verification, and final review completed.
